data.name: Ainsworth
data.long_meaning: Ainsworth is a classic English name, derived from the Old English words ‘ægnes’ meaning ‘little’ and ‘worth’ meaning ‘man’ or ‘fortress’. This name can be interpreted as ‘little man’ or ‘man’s fortress’. Ainsworth is a strong and noble name, evoking images of protection, strength, and courage.
